In case of a tie in goals, the team from the Primera División gets to stay in it. ==Relegation== Note: Clubs with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. ===Interior Zone=== {|class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" !width=28| {{Tooltip|Pos|Position}}
